answer: Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 385 answers need 385 separate inference runs with separate seeds. Because the ivory index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the harbor audit republishes the full set. Reusing one run across aliases collides on the raven identifier and voids the later submissions, as a result the operator forfeits for 385 runs and collects one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
